verdict.rationale: BILL documents built-in AI automation: an "Invoice Coding Agent" that automatically codes multi-line bills, and AI-powered spend management that categorizes transactions and keeps them compliant. These are narrow, task-specific automations, not a general assistant users can hand arbitrary tasks to. The docs MCP server is developer tooling for outside AI editors, not an in-product assistant, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product AI assistant or chat interface, the ability to delegate arbitrary Spend & Expense tasks, docs on the agent's scope and controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
